necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. This service addresses the clinical need for diagnosis code R55 associated with the patient's cardiac history.
